newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Software Connection to list on JSE.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Software Connection to list on JSE.

text.p: South African software retailer Software Connection Group is set to list on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) later this year in a move that will raise 48 million rand, the firm said on Monday.
The firm was formed in May, 1996, from a management buy-out from Persetel and intends to float with a private placing and a public offer.

"The funds raised from the offer will be employed to reduce debt resulting from the management buyout from Persetel, to facilitate further expansion of the group, to enhance corporate awareness and to reduce gearing," said chief executive Philip Cowles.
The listing will not include the firm's Incredible Connection unit, as the division was only founded in 1995 and is seen as needing a longer trading history.

"Once the division has a more robust financial track record behind it, we will list it on the JSE in one form or another and existing Software Conection shareholders will have pre-emptive rights to these shares," Cowles said.
